proposed.explanation: Residential standardization (not customization) is industry practice for cost and quality control. Color variation is not 'expected'; consistency is the standard. Adjacency is irrelevant; consistency applies to all same-type units. Unit 201 is fully specified (brand, code); Unit 301 is vague. Vagueness on Unit 301 allows contractor substitution, color mismatch, and quality variance. Bulk purchasing is impossible with mixed specs. Standard practice: all standard units use identical finishes; custom finishes are documented separately with cost tracking. Standardize finishes for like spaces. Custom finishes are exceptions, documented separately with cost approval. Avoid mix of specific and vague specs.
